Method of Attack: Steals credentials stored in iCloud KeyChain and web browsers
Steals cryptocurrency wallets and sensitive files
Distributes as unsigned DMG file posing as legitimate software
Uses fake password prompt to run commands to collect passwords
Collects data and stores in ZIP file sent to remote command and control servers
Sends basic info to pre-configured Telegram channel for operator notification
Impacted Systems: macOS Catalina (10.15) and later versions including Big Sur, Monterey, Ventura (13.2)
Attack Vector: Unsigned DMG file distributed to victims, social engineering via fake password prompt
Date of Discovery: Beginning of the month (relative to article date)
